d: A foiled alleged mass shooting plot targeting a Hindu temple in Aurora, Illinois, has reignited concerns over rising anti-Indian and anti-Hindu hatred in America. From chilling threats and racist online posts to anti-immigrant rhetoric in Donald Trump’s political landscape, this report examines how digital hate can spill into the real world. We investigate the alleged attacker’s plans, the growing hostility confronting Indian-Americans, and research documenting a sharp rise in anti-South Asian hate online. As questions of immigration, race and belonging intensify, a troubling question…
